booking.title: Court booking
booking.heading: Book a court
booking.note: Prices follow the club's rules. Log in with the email on a membership to get the member price.
booking.reminderEmail: Email me a reminder before this booking
booking.reminderPhone: Reminder phone, only if you want a text
booking.reminderSms: Text me a reminder. This is not marketing.
booking.empty: No slots yet. Add courts, times, and prices in admin.
booking.cardNote: Continue on the card provider's page. The booking confirms when their webhook arrives. Test mode does not charge a real card.
booking.payNote: Pay this invoice from a Lightning wallet. The booking confirms when the payment settles.
booking.mockNote: Mock backend: this invoice cannot be paid. Confirm it from the admin page. A real BTCPay or LNbits backend replaces this.
booking.expired: The hold expired and the slot was released.
booking.memberLoginNote: The member price applies when you are logged in on your bookings.
booking.holdFor: We'll hold this time for {minutes} minutes while you pay.
booking.holdWhile: We'll hold this time while you pay.
booking.truncated: This day has more times than the page can load. Ask the club if a time you need is missing.
booking.noTimes: No times on this day. Pick another date.
account.title: My bookings
account.heading: My bookings
account.note: A login code arrives by email. It is not a marketing message. Cancel only inside the club's window.
account.languageNote: The language menu on this page is kept in this browser until you close it. After you log in, that choice is also saved on your profile and used for email and texts.
account.tabNote: Drinks and small items draw the membership allowance first. The rest stays on the tab until you settle it. A guest item is listed with the guest's name and is still your tab.
account.loggedIn: Logged in as {email}. Cancel at least {hours} hours ahead. Refunds: {refund}.
account.noAllowance: This membership has no allowance set.
account.tabFrozen: The tab is frozen. Ask the desk.
account.enterEmail: Enter your email to get a code.
kiosk.title: Door kiosk
kiosk.heading: Member entry
kiosk.safetyEntry: This service can pulse an entry lock only. It cannot lock a door shut, block an exit, or control fire or other life-safety systems.
kiosk.safetyFallback: If this screen cannot reach the club server, use a fob, a PIN, or staff. Leaving does not use this service.
kiosk.uidWarning: UID-only cards are clonable. This mode is for development and is not an access control.
kiosk.noscript: Wallet sign-in needs this page's script and the local server. Use a fob, a PIN, or staff. Exits do not use this screen.
kiosk.unreachable: Access server unreachable. Use a fob, a PIN, or staff. Exits stay available without this screen.
kiosk.chooseArea: Choose an area. The QR proves a wallet, then pulses entry only.
kiosk.scan: Scan with an enrolled Lightning wallet.
kiosk.fallbackSuffix: Use a fob, a PIN, or staff if you cannot get in.
kiosk.entryPulsed: Entry pulsed. The strike releases on its own. You can always leave without this screen.
kiosk.overLimit: That is over the guest limit.
kiosk.reason.door-failed: Entry controller did not respond. Use a fob, PIN, or staff.
kiosk.reason.outside-hours: That area is closed right now.
kiosk.reason.replay: That code or card counter was already used.
kiosk.reason.default: Entry was not granted. Use a fob, PIN, or staff if you need to get in.
guest.title: Guest
guest.heading: Guest check-in
guest.note: The club keeps the name and contact so staff know who is on site. Marketing is a separate choice.
guest.name: Name
guest.waiver: I acknowledge the club waiver for this visit.
guest.marketing: Send me club news. Leave this unchecked if you do not want that.
guest.added: Guest added. A privacy link was created for this contact.
enroll.title: Enroll a wallet
enroll.heading: Enroll a Lightning wallet
enroll.note: Staff create this code in admin and show it to the member. The wallet's linking key is stored. No name, email, or balance is requested.
enroll.openFromAdmin: Open the enrollment link from the admin page.
enroll.scan: Scan with the wallet that should open the door.
enroll.unavailable: This code is no longer available.
enroll.done: Wallet enrolled. You can close this page.
enroll.failed: Enrollment did not finish. Ask staff for a new code.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.heading: Privacy choices
privacy.disclaimer: This page is a template for the club's own notice. It is not legal advice. Ask a lawyer about US state privacy laws, CAN-SPAM, TCPA, and GDPR where they apply.
privacy.body: Operational visit records and marketing contacts are stored separately. Unsubscribing stops marketing. Deletion clears the contact stored with this privacy link.
desk.title: Front desk
desk.heading: On site now
desk.safety: This screen shows who arrived. It does not lock an exit or touch fire systems.
desk.chargeNote: The allowance is used first. Anything left goes on the tab. A guest charge stays on the hosting member and records the guest. Amounts are whole minor units the club set. Use the same request id again only for the same charge.
desk.guestId: Guest id, if this item is for a guest
admin.title: Club admin
admin.heading: Courts, prices, and members
admin.priceNote: Prices are integers in your currency's minor units. Nothing on this page fills in a price for you.
admin.token: Or an admin or staff token
admin.brandNote: The name, logo, and colors members see on the booking page, the kiosk, receipts, and email.
admin.shortNote: Shown in the page header and at the start of email subjects.
admin.fontNote: Fonts already on the computer. This app does not load a font from another site.
admin.footerLinksNote: Optional. Use an http or https address for your club's own page.
admin.defaultLanguageNote: Used when a member has not chosen a language and the browser does not ask for one this club supports. Members can still switch. Portuguese uses Brazilian Portuguese until a Portugal catalog is added.
admin.logoNote: PNG, JPG, or SVG, up to 512 KB. SVG files that contain a script are refused. Do not upload the BitPadel placeholder logo.
admin.favicon: Favicon, PNG, JPG, SVG, or ICO
admin.membersNote: Use a membership number or other label. Do not put a person's name here unless your privacy policy says so.
admin.label: Label
admin.allowanceNote: The club sets this amount. It is a recurring credit for one membership type. Spending uses the allowance first, then the tab. Unused credit from an earlier period is not paid out. Before a club uses this, a CPA and a Florida attorney should review stored value, unused balances, sales tax on items, and sats accounting.
admin.ledgerNote: Each line is kept. Amounts are whole minor units. A credit reduces the tab. A charge can also record sats when the club set a sats-per-minor rate.
admin.staffNote: Owners and managers can add accounts. A manager cannot create an owner. The admin token still works.
admin.name: Name
admin.priceRulesNote: Weekdays are 0 Sunday through 6 Saturday, in the club timezone. A court-specific rule beats an all-courts rule. Leave court blank for every court.
admin.salesNote: Lightning bookings and stored Playtomic payment rows in the date range. Playtomic amounts stay as imported text.
admin.endOfDayNote: Totals by Lightning, Stripe, Square, and refunds. Card totals appear after a webhook confirms the payment.
admin.auditNote: Who called an admin route, and when. Owners and managers can read this. The shared admin token is recorded as admin-token.
admin.marketingNote: This sends only if that contact opted in. Receipts, privacy links, and household notices are transactional and use the providers in the environment.
admin.subject: Subject
admin.playtomicNote: Read-only import. This app never writes bookings back to Playtomic.
admin.prototype: Prototype — not yet tested with real money or real doors.
admin.guestCap: Guest cap, blank uses the club default
tap.title: Checked in
